title: Network Security
prerequisites: To enrol in this course, you must have completed: COMP2700 AND COMP3310 or ENGN3539 .
requisite_raw: To enrol in this course, you must have completed: COMP2700 AND COMP3310 or ENGN3539 .  Incompatible with COMP6034 .
description: This course covers a range of concepts, techniques and technologies in network security. This includes an overview of relevant network protocols and cryptography; analyses of designs and implementations of security protocols, including basic tools and techniques; an understanding of network threats and attacks such as eavesdropping, spoofing, protocol failures, DoS attacks and man-in-the-middle attacks; network defence including threat analysis and identification, architecture control, intrusion detection and layered security. The course features hands-on lectures and labs to analyse network vulnerabilities, and design and implement appropriate defensive techniques.
learning_outcomes: Understand various threats and vulnerabilities of a network, and explain appropriate countermeasures
Perform simple penetration testing of a network and network services
Perform a threat analysis / vulnerability assessment of protocol designs and implementations
Design and implement appropriate defensive countermeasures against identified threats and vulnerabilities
